integrity_notes: Exact stars-and-bars proof and a standalone rational-arithmetic and independent-enumeration checker. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact covariance signs are established for cyclic category counts 3, 4, and 5 and all nonnegative totals; for larger categories, heterogeneous Dirichlet parameters, and higher moments, no classification is claimed. A broader older enumerative generating function could implicitly yield the formulas.
title: Vacancy–neighbor equality covariance on three-, four-, and five-category cycles
